connector.name: Docjet MCP
connector.registryDescription: Render branded PDFs and PNG images from templates or raw HTML via the DocJet API. Free tier.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package docjet-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the docjet-dev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DOCJET_API_KEY
env.description: DocJet API key (get one free at https://docjet.dev — POST /v1/signup)

env.name: DOCJET_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://api.docjet.dev)
